ai_assistant_workflow_issues.description: Real-world AI assistant workflow problems in n8n

core_issues.title: Tool Ignoring Long Execution Times
core_issues.problem: AI tools don't wait for long-running operations
core_issues.symptom: Tool completes before operation finishes, causing incorrect responses
core_issues.root_cause: Timeout settings too aggressive or tool response validation too quick
core_issues.impact: Incomplete data passed to subsequent steps

core_issues.title: Incorrect AI Assistant Responses
core_issues.problem: AI returns wrong information despite correct inputs
core_issues.symptom: AI hallucinates or provides outdated/cached information
core_issues.root_cause: Context not properly passed, memory not cleared, prompt engineering weak

core_issues.title: Tool Response Handling
core_issues.problem: Tools return data in unexpected formats
core_issues.symptom: Workflow fails or produces garbage output
core_issues.root_cause: No validation of tool output format, missing error handling
core_issues.impact: Workflow crashes or produces silent failures

core_issues.title: Context Management
core_issues.symptom: Performance degrades, costs increase, responses slow
core_issues.root_cause: Entire conversation history passed to each call

core_issues.title: Memory and State
core_issues.symptom: Repeated questions, lost information, inconsistent behavior
core_issues.root_cause: No persistent memory layer, state reset between calls
